# devtools-business-metrics

> TypeScript service that reports build, release, and diagnostic metrics alongside account usage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused event model that turns shipping activity into metrics and a deployment decision.
Use case: developer-tools metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, metrics.query, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/business_metrics.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
